description: Every controller-availability requirement mapped to its lifecycle boundary, expected observable result, implementing owner, and current evidence (add-controller-high-availability 1.1). status: verified = covered by a merged test; pending = not yet implemented or tested.

requirements.requirement: Two-replica default with explicit development mode
requirements.expected: chart defaults replicaCount 2; development values set 1 explicitly
requirements.evidence: internal/charttest TestRuntimeChartDefaults (2 replicas, election on), TestRuntimeChartDevelopment and TestDocumentedExamples/development.yaml (explicit 1, election on); TestLiveHelmInstall installs 2 ready replicas with a Lease holder

requirements.expected: preferred hostname anti-affinity weight 100; replicas may co-locate
requirements.evidence: rendered: TestRuntimeChartDefaults; deployed: TestLiveHelmAvailability placement (two workers, replicas apart) and co-location with one worker cordoned

requirements.requirement: Disruption protection matches the replica configuration
requirements.expected: minAvailable 1 PDB when replicas > 1; none for one replica
requirements.evidence: rendered: TestRuntimeChartDefaults/Development; deployed: TestLiveHelmAvailability second eviction refused (429), development values render no PDB and a drain proceeds

requirements.requirement: Rolling upgrades retain ready serving capacity
requirements.expected: maxUnavailable 0, maxSurge 1; replacement ready before retirement
requirements.evidence: rendered: TestRuntimeChartDefaults; deployed: TestLiveHelmAvailability rolling upgrade (min 2 ready) and a capacity-blocked surge that keeps both serving

requirements.expected: one Lease holder among simultaneous candidates; only the holder reconciles; a candidate without Lease access never leads
requirements.evidence: TestLiveLeaderElection (follower field manager on no written object), TestElectionTimings, TestBackgroundWorkersNeedLeadership; TestLiveLeaderObservability (follower exposes no owner metric projections; the successor exposes a domain only with its reconstructed state)

requirements.expected: leadership loss cancels work; stale writes conflict and re-resolve
requirements.evidence: TestLiveBoundedShutdown (cancel on Lease loss); TestDelayedFormerLeaderResolvesAgain, TestDelayedFormerLeaderCannotWithdrawTheNewRevision, TestDeleteRequiresTheListedObject (stale snapshot and delete preconditions); s3store TestStagePublishAndRecover, TestConflictingContentNeverOverwrites (same run identity); publication fault fixtures across independent clients (lost stage/commit responses, same-run conflicting bytes, concurrent successors): shared fake stores in internal/publication/fake and internal/s3store TestPublicationFaults, durable backend TestLivePublicationFaults (RustFS, three versioning modes)

requirements.requirement: Serving readiness is independent of leadership
requirements.expected: ready followers serve admission/downloads; readiness ignores leadership and engine health
requirements.evidence: downloads: TestLiveHelmInstall (both controller pods ready with one Lease holder; each download pod serves with no controller, readiness follows TLS); controller readiness = informer sync + verified webhook TLS + not stopping: TestInformerSyncGatesReadiness, TestWebhookReadinessFollowsTLS, TestWebhookTLSValidatedAtStartup, TestServingRunnablesNeedNoLeadership; admission: TestLiveReplicaAdmission (assessments group) — follower ready and serving while one replica leads, survivor serves before it is elected, expired webhook rotation makes one replica unready but live while the other serves, unavailable OCI content fails only that namespace's admission

requirements.expected: every replica applies authoritative admission checks; no grant broadened by failover
requirements.evidence: TestLiveReplicaAdmission (assessments group): central restrictions deny acceptance, renewal and dry run at once on leader, follower and a leaderless survivor; attribution is the authenticated caller on every replica; dry runs store nothing; failover rewrites no acceptance, renews nothing and changes no snapshot; acceptances made without a leader are snapshotted as accepted. Native grant delivery is not implemented yet (add-self-service-policy-exceptions groups 3-4, waiting on upstream Kyverno), so native-grant revival across failover is re-verified by its 6.4 (formerly availability 3.6); native exception support is not HA-validated until then

requirements.requirement: Downloads do not depend on the elected pod
requirements.expected: any download-server replica serves the durable package with current authorization
requirements.evidence: TestLiveHelmInstall followerDownloads (charts group): controller scaled to 0; each download pod serves receipt-identical packages, applies revocation, audience, credential rotation, S3 outage (503) and namespace-UID isolation; no secrets logged

requirements.expected: successor recovers staged/committed packages with identity and expiry; loss before staging is CaptureLost
requirements.evidence: TestLiveAssessmentFaults (restart, single process); TestLiveLeaderHandoverRecovery (staged package committed by the successor with the original identity and bytes, outage not CaptureLost); TestLiveLeaderHandoverLoss (lost receipt: original commit, publishedAt and expiry under the committed retention; lost capture: CaptureLost, nothing committed, next run a new identity); on the Helm-installed image with two replicas, TestLiveHelmDurableRecovery (S3 fault proxy: staged-not-committed run committed by the other replica with the exact staged archive and the binding retention at commit; committed-without-receipt run recorded with the original commit and expiry; Publishing, never CaptureLost, while S3 is held); TestLiveHelmFailoverTraffic: the same staged run committed once with the staged archive after a graceful leader replacement and after node loss, and a truthful CaptureLost (nothing in S3, the next run publishes) after abrupt leader loss during collection

requirements.requirement: Replica-local state is reconstructible or explicitly unavailable
requirements.expected: local caches rebuilt or reported unavailable; watch gaps recorded
requirements.evidence: TestSuccessorWithUnverifiableContentKeepsPolicies, TestUnavailableContentKeepsAppliedPolicies, TestLocalContentRejectsTamperedFiles, TestRestartResumesSameCaptureWithoutContinuity, TestLiveEngineCapabilityRecovery; TestLiveHelmBundles: a successor whose cache holds content verified earlier delivers nothing new after trust is rotated to a key that did not sign it (registry down) and keeps the applied policy; per-pod budgets and staging documented

requirements.expected: 45s application and 20s HTTP drain budgets within 60s grace; readiness fails while draining; no owned child processes
requirements.evidence: TestLiveBoundedShutdown, TestServeDrainIsBounded, TestShutdownTimeoutValidated; TestLiveLeaderObservability (Lease loss and stop clear the leader-scoped metric projections and refuse old-term writes); on the installed image, TestLiveHelmFailoverTraffic (availability group) removes the follower and then the leader gracefully under traffic: each pod is gone within the 45s budget plus 10s (never SIGKILLed), and the leader's held S3 commit ends with its process and is never forwarded

requirements.expected: applied policies keep enforcing while the controller or its access is lost
requirements.evidence: TestLiveEngineCapabilityRecovery (permission loss retains enforcement, engine rollout); TestLiveHelmAvailability controller outage (Kyverno keeps enforcing and downloads keep serving with no controller); TestLiveHelmFailoverTraffic: a privileged dry-run pod is denied by the delivered policy every second through graceful follower/leader replacement, abrupt leader loss, leader API loss and node loss, and the policies keep their names, UIDs and specs; the leader cut off from the API server stops, commits nothing it held and serves no metrics while the successor takes over

requirements.expected: multi-node chart acceptance covering leader failure, eviction, upgrade, node loss
requirements.evidence: availability acceptance group TestLiveHelmAvailability (multi-node kind, packaged image): leader pod loss, evictions/PDB, rolling and constrained upgrades, controller outage, leader loss during S3 outage; staged-byte and lost-receipt recovery on the installed image via TestLiveHelmDurableRecovery (also in-process TestLiveLeaderHandover*); failover under traffic in TestLiveHelmFailoverTraffic (graceful follower and leader replacement, abrupt leader failure, leader API loss with a download grant revoked meanwhile, node loss; Service-routed downloads and admission probes throughout with bounded, recorded transient failures; reconciliation and owner metrics on the Lease holder only)
